zh.title: 桃園機場第二航廈電梯故障23人受困均已安全脫困
zh.summary: 桃園機場第二航廈電梯發生故障；23名旅客受困近一小時後順利安全脫困
body: 桃園國際機場（TPE）今日上午發生旅客受困電梯事件。第二航廈北側擴建區的N7電梯於上午9時40分發出緊急告警，經機場公司透過監視系統確認，共有23名民眾受困於電梯內。機場公司立即派員並通知電梯維修廠商前往現場搶修。
由於期間有部分旅客反映身體不適，桃園機場公司同步通知醫療單位與桃園市政府消防局派遣救護人員到場待命。經維護人員緊急處置，電梯門於上午10時34分順利開啟，受困的23名民眾安全脫困，經醫療人員現場確認後身體狀況皆無大礙。
據了解，星宇航空的「空山金」彩繪機於16日上午降落桃園機場，吸引大批航空迷前往觀景台守候。部分受困民眾在社群平台上發文表示，因受困電梯而遺憾錯過該班彩繪機。機場公司對此事件致歉，並表示將釐清故障原因與加強設備巡檢。

en.title: Twenty-Three People Trapped in Taoyuan Airport Elevator Safely Freed
en.summary: 23 people trapped in a Taoyuan Airport elevator were safely rescued after nearly one hour.
body: An elevator malfunction occurred at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) on the morning of August 16, trapping 23 people. The N7 elevator located in the North Expansion Area of Terminal 2 triggered an emergency alarm at 9:40 AM. The Taoyuan International Airport Corporation dispatched maintenance personnel and elevator technicians immediately after confirming the situation.

As some trapped passengers reported feeling unwell, medical personnel and the Taoyuan City Fire Department were also dispatched to stand by. Maintenance workers successfully opened the elevator doors at 10:34 AM, freeing all 23 individuals, who were found to be in stable condition after medical checkups.

The incident occurred as aviation enthusiasts gathered to watch Starlux Airlines' 'Kong Shan Jin' livery aircraft land. Some trapped individuals posted online that they missed the aircraft due to the incident. The airport company apologized and promised to investigate the cause.
